verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe official Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive connectors that let Claude search email, manage the calendar and work with documents inside the conversation. A unified connector directory and custom remote MCP connectors extend this to other tools. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connector search quality, and documented support for non-Google drive, mail or calendar providers (e.g. Microsoft 365) beyond custom MCP.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can connect my cloud drive, email, and calendar so the assistant can search and use them in answers

citations.quote: Connect your Gmail, Google Calendar, and Google Drive to Claude so you can search and send emails, manage your calendar, work with documents, and save files—all without leaving the conversation.
We do not train our models on your Gmail, Drive, or Calendar connector data, ensuring your private information remains private.
Our unified directory brings skills, connectors, and plugins together in one place so you can find and install everything that customizes Claude
Connect Claude to existing remote MCP servers. Build your own remote MCP servers to connect with any tool.
